verdict.rationale: Lovable explicitly supports downloading the codebase or syncing to GitHub/GitLab, enabling local editing, self-hosting, and deployment outside the platform; this is well-documented across multiple doc pages. Community evidence corroborates that exported code can be used with other tools (e.g., moved to Cursor/Astro), though some note code quality issues, which is a caveat but not a denial of export capability.
